text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final stop of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho. Completely unfazed by the 
cheers echoing all the way to the waiting 
room, Mejiro Dober remained focused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before heading out to the race, 
Mejiro Dober powerfully declared that she 
would show everyone the culmination of her 
Triple Tiara journey...!
